```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Decades of massive development assistance have failed to spur economic growth in the poorest countries.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Development aid has often served to prop up failed policies, relieving the pressure for reform and perpetuating misery.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Results of aid are typically measured in dollars spent by donors, not in the rates of growth and poverty reduction achieved by recipients.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Measuring aid results in dollars spent by donors, rather than growth and poverty reduction rates, indicates a failed strategy.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States, under the leadership of President Bush and the Republican Congress, has confronted the failure of decades of massive development assistance.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Bush helped to forge a new consensus at the United Nations Conference on Financing for Development in Monterrey that the objectives and strategies of assistance must change.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans support President Bush's goal to help unleash the productive potential of individuals in all nations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Sustained growth and poverty reduction are impossible without the right national policies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The United States will provide significant new levels of assistance where governments have implemented real policy changes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The United States and other developed countries should set an ambitious and specific target to double the size of the world's poorest economies within a decade.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
